lines: I won't forget, even as time goes by
our playful back-and-forth,
even the thorn in my heart — when you smiled,
it would curl up small
Through the holes we peeked at in turns,
what did we see, I wonder?
There were dreams, too,
that I couldn't make come true alone
Goodbye — holding your voice, I'll walk on
Ah, still as I am, how far will I reach?
I was searching, until the day I met you
words that feel nostalgic now
Beyond the glass, polka-dotted clouds
lay scattered — back to that day
With a light soul that felt
like the wind could blow it away,
I believed in a happiness
just like everyone else's
From now on, even if I get hurt, even if I hurt someone,
Ah, still as I am, how far will I reach?
A season as long as a blink comes,
and the names we call each other begin to echo
Can you hear it?
Goodbye — holding your voice, I'll walk on
Ah, still as I am, how far will I reach?
Ah, holding your voice, I'll walk on
Ah, still as I am, how far will I reach?
Ah, your voice...
